definitions.explanation: Changing the structure or organization of something, such as a company, military unit, or system.
Adapting or revising content such as a book, script, or curriculum.

examples.japanese: {部署|ぶしょ}の{改編|かいへん}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: The restructuring of the department was announced.

examples.japanese: {軍|ぐん}の{大規模|だいきぼ}な{改編|かいへん}が{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: A large-scale reorganization of the military was carried out.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{小説|しょうせつ}を{改編|かいへん}したものだ。
examples.english: This movie is an adaptation of the novel.

examples.japanese: {教育課程|きょういくかてい}の{改編|かいへん}について{議論|ぎろん}された。
examples.english: The revision of the curriculum was discussed.

examples.japanese: {組織|そしき}{改編|かいへん}により、{新|あたら}しい{部門|ぶもん}が{誕生|たんじょう}した。
examples.english: A new division was created through organizational restructuring.

examples.japanese: {原作|げんさく}を{大幅|おおはば}に{改編|かいへん}して{舞台化|ぶたいか}した。
examples.english: The original work was significantly adapted for the stage.

notes:
COMPARISON:
・{改編|かいへん} - reorganization, adaptation (changing structure or content)
・{改訂|かいてい} - revision (updating/correcting existing content)
・{改正|かいせい} - amendment (revising laws or regulations)
・{改革|かいかく} - reform (larger-scale fundamental change)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{組織|そしき}{改編|かいへん} - organizational restructuring
・{番組|ばんぐみ}{改編|かいへん} - TV program schedule changes
・{軍|ぐん}の{改編|かいへん} - military reorganization
・カリキュラムの{改編|かいへん} - curriculum revision
